googleImagesAccess: Attempted; Google Images was inaccessible through the available web tool. Computer-use browser is disabled.
method: Fallback image-search visual descriptions plus primary educational and museum references; no source image pixels reused.
observations: Common results emphasize a curved horn-shaped basket spilling harvest food; a generic bowl would be semantically wrong.
Flowers, foliage, grain and horn-shaped bouquet holders provide legitimate useful variations beyond repeated fruit recolors.
designDecisions: Fifty independent silhouettes and use cases spanning food, flowers, crafts, people, woodland story scenes and six coloring outlines.
Keep the horn central and recognizable in every scene; preserve physically plausible humans, produce and baskets.
No source-image reuse, brand marks, visible notes, country words, duplicated stock silhouettes or recolor-only variants.
All standard PDFs remain under 1000000 bytes with genuine four-channel CMYK and a registered GRACoL output intent; native transparent WebP remains lossless.
